text: 数据显示，下周央行公开市场将有18420亿元逆回购到期，其中，下周一至周五分别到期9255亿元、3055亿元、2065亿元、2705亿元、1340亿元。此外，8月5日还将有3000亿元3个月期买断式逆回购到期。（人民财讯）
text_en: Data show that RMB 1.842 trillion in reverse repos will mature in the central bank's open market operations next week, with RMB 925.5 billion, 305.5 billion, 206.5 billion, 270.5 billion, and 134 billion maturing from Monday to Friday respectively. Additionally, RMB 300 billion in 3-month outright reverse repos will mature on Aug 5. (People's Financial News)
